name: LocalAI adds Strata as a backend for running large MoE models on ordinary hardware
title: LocalAI adds Strata as a backend for running large MoE models on ordinary hardware
summary: LocalAI can now run coldniko's Strata engine next to its own backends, so its agents and multi-machine setup can use Strata's offloading for big mixture-of-experts models.
